items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: because Billy made arrangements for us on Flamingo

ctx.x: Oh, I would think I probably have,

because Billy made arrangements for us on Flamingo -- made the identical same arrangements they had, and he condensed it so our four instruments could play it, and we started the same way they did, and you know, he was pretty sharp as a writer.
Wasn't that his first arrangement for Duke? The vocal arrangement of "Flamingo"?
